# Vantorre renewal debrief

July 9, 2026

**Attendees:** Mateo Quiroga, Head of Procurement, Vantorre Group; me, Strategic Accounts, Pemberline Systems  
**Topic:** Pemberline Dock renewal prep. Quick call, mostly procurement questions and the receiving team's loose ends.

## Call notes

- Vantorre Group has to give 60 days' notice if they don't want another year. Told Mateo to put that in the procurement checklist so it doesn't disappear behind the plant purchasing queue.
- Mateo wants the renewal material in one email. Not separate threads for the product questions and the paperwork. Said he spent part of yesterday hunting through forwarded messages with identical subject lines.
- Receiving issue still irritating people: at the Northeast plant, the afternoon dispatcher moves a booking from door 4 to door 6, but the printed arrival sheet still shows the old door. Driver then walks to the wrong window. Need an actual example, not another screenshot of the calendar after everything is corrected.
- Mateo will ask the receiving supervisor for the booking reference and the time the sheet was printed. Apparently the printer beside the check-in window is also streaking, which made the last example hard to read.
- Keep Vantorre Mobility out of this email chain. Mateo wants the Vantorre Group discussion readable without subsidiary questions mixed into every reply.
- No pricing discussion on this call. Main ask was less back-and-forth and a clean list of what procurement needs to do.

## Actions

- **Me:** Send recap and request the original arrival-sheet PDF. Include door numbers in the subject so receiving can find it.
- **Mateo:** Collect the booking example; send procurement's outstanding questions together.
- **Me:** Reproduce the door-change/print sequence before opening a support ticket. Check print preview too.
- **Me:** Get the paperwork packet togehter. Leave room for Mateo's questions; don't send another half-finished bundle.
